scope: Packaging and known-private-material checks of current unsigned release outputs. No publication, permanent signing identity, complete vulnerability scan or runtime compatibility claim.

privateScan.limitation: Clean CI has no local private fixture credentials; only available known values and test markers are scanned. This is not an exhaustive secret audit.

runtimeAssessment: ARM64 only: debug JNI loads for three libraries, WebRTC factory create/dispose, and recording playback; release APK from current AAB launches without test CA. API36 graphics-path UI uses the system PathIterator, so its native path-iteration operations are not established by this test. x86_64 and all other native operations/devices remain unverified.
